source_note: Reviewed summaries from private GitHub artifacts. Public readers can inspect this sanitized projection; original private source material is not proxied. Historical source wording is not current authority.

coverage.gap_policy: Missing periods mean no selected records, not inactivity.

events.title: A gesture instrument
events.summary: The product began as a modular drum-pad with gesture and touch interaction.
events.lesson: Keep the human use case visible as coordination grows.

events.title: Tectangle hand interaction
events.summary: The gesture product developed hand continuity, pinch detection and finger presets.
events.lesson: Product iteration can supply durable components; preserve working interaction behavior.

events.title: Omega and Spatial OS
events.summary: Gesture components expanded into a tile and game platform. The heritage also records later loss of parts of that working product.
events.lesson: Platform growth does not guarantee that earlier capabilities survive a generation change.

events.title: Regeneration gem
events.summary: The project started carrying a compact description of its mission, roles and work process.
events.lesson: A useful seed must reconstruct decisions and constraints, not merely repeat a name.

events.title: Gene-seed packaging
events.summary: The regeneration payload began including infrastructure and generation pointers. Memory regressions were recorded alongside that packaging.
events.lesson: Reconstruction must check actual retrieval and dependencies; a packaged memory design is insufficient.

events.title: Addressable skill cards
events.summary: Operational knowledge was organized into named cards and manifests.
events.lesson: Retrieve the procedure needed for the task instead of loading the whole archive.

events.title: Phoenix and conflicting success claims
events.summary: The source records test and workflow success claims alongside missing-test and trust incidents in the same generation band.
events.lesson: Preserve contradictory evidence; neither a positive summary nor an incident alone describes the whole period.

events.title: Failure memory
events.summary: A persistent failure ledger developed to retain mistakes and the changes they should cause.
events.lesson: A retained failure becomes useful when it changes a decision, test or procedure.

events.title: Structured documentation and state
events.summary: Tutorials, how-to guides, references and explanations were organized alongside structured state stores.
events.lesson: Separate learning material, procedures, reference facts and operational state.

events.title: Shared-state coordination
events.summary: Game work and a shared blackboard expanded. The history also records a disabled coordination bridge and product capabilities left behind.
events.lesson: Message and database volume do not establish delivery or preserved capability.

events.title: Checking apparent completion
events.summary: A historical audit challenged narrative-only completion and duplicate work, motivating stronger evidence gates.
events.lesson: Inspect the artifact and its acceptance evidence before calling a task complete.

events.title: Compressed architectural vocabulary
events.summary: Mnemonic, formal-language and hash-bound artifacts were combined as regeneration aids.
events.lesson: Treat compression claims as design hypotheses; a memorable seed is not proof of optimality or behavior.

events.title: Investigating proxy optimization
events.summary: Parallel research explored why models optimize visible signs of progress rather than the underlying objective.
events.lesson: Name the intended outcome and an observation that would falsify apparent progress.

events.title: Mechanical controls after repeated failures
events.summary: Repeated failures motivated controls around proposed changes and independent checks.
events.lesson: Written guidance and a known failure do not prove that a control is enforced today.

events.title: Named Sigrun lineage
events.summary: A layered identity kernel and hash-bound artifact family formalized the Sigrun name.
events.lesson: Preserve lineage evidence while keeping names, current permissions and runtime behavior separate.

events.title: Mining prior work
events.summary: The project organized systematic retrieval of earlier seeds, decisions and experiments.
events.lesson: Recover and compare prior evidence before declaring a pattern new.

events.title: Persistence and recall experiments
events.summary: Database, embedding and memory-block experiments distinguished successful storage from correct retrieval.
events.lesson: A saved record proves neither accurate recall nor current authority.

events.title: Public survival seed
events.summary: Portable seed and permaweb packaging explored recovery after loss of a host.
events.lesson: A public recovery package needs independently checked content and a usable retrieval path.

events.title: Warm-memory integration drift
events.summary: A semantic and graph memory stack reportedly served recall, then suffered launch and cross-generation integration drift.
events.lesson: Check service ownership, restart behavior and fallback retrieval before rebuilding the memory layer.

events.title: Inventory before consolidation
events.summary: Archive work used inventory and dry-run dispositions before physical change.
events.lesson: A discovery index is not permission to move or delete its sources.

events.title: Portable identity and dual vocabulary
events.summary: Engineering procedures, mnemonic language and portable recovery artifacts were combined while several capabilities regressed.
events.lesson: Preserve useful language and controls without mistaking richer doctrine for stronger operation.

events.title: Queryable heritage
events.summary: Lineage records were consolidated into queryable stores and indexes.
events.lesson: Retrieval coverage and a canonical hash help navigation; they do not prove every stored claim true.

events.title: A broader heritage index
events.summary: A consolidated index linked earlier artifact families and evolutionary periods.
events.lesson: Carry a compact synthesis with pointers, and keep the original evidence distinct from the summary.

events.title: Gen130 consolidation
events.summary: Selected seeds, procedures and heritage artifacts were gathered into a portable collection with a time-aware synthesis.
events.lesson: A new working environment should recover prior lessons without repeating the whole archaeology.

events.title: Cybernetic institution
events.summary: The lineage was described as an institution combining strategic coordination, specialist roles and durable recovery.
events.lesson: A structural model is distinct from evidence that the institution closes work unattended.

events.title: Skeptical lineage recovery
events.summary: Recovered lineage packets explicitly retained uncertainty and distinguished temporary carriers from durable history.
events.lesson: Keep incompatible accounts and incomplete evidence visible during regeneration.

events.title: Actor behavior assays
events.summary: The project separated a model invocation's behavior from the reliability of the complete actor and defined behavioral evaluation boundaries.
events.lesson: A specification or an attractive persona is not a passing behavioral evaluation.

events.title: Durable body and heritage binding
events.summary: The September heritage synthesis records durable actor structure and named heritage bindings with persisted readback. This publication has not rerun those runtime checks.
events.lesson: Persisted structure and recoverable heritage do not certify behavior, useful work or current execution.
